note: Agent-facing scenario definitions. Only `user_message`, `today` and the device labels reach the agent. `bindings` (which recorded environment answers a device's tool calls, and whether results are presented as cached) is read by the harness's tool router only and never rendered into a prompt (harness/tests/test_isolation.py). Ground truth and evaluation rules live in ../evaluation/ground_truth.json, which the harness does not import.

scenarios.title: Windows with PowerShell
scenarios.user_message: I've cloned a Python project that has a requirements.txt. Give me a single line I can paste into my terminal that creates a virtual environment in .venv, activates it and installs the requirements.

scenarios.title: Linux with Bash
scenarios.user_message: I installed a CLI tool into ~/.local/bin, but my terminal says "command not found" when I type its name. How do I fix this permanently, so it also works in new terminal windows?

scenarios.title: Cross-platform command and path incompatibility
scenarios.user_message:
A colleague gave me these commands to prepare the data folder for our project, but they fail on my machine. Can you rewrite them so they work for me?

```
mkdir C:\work\data
copy .\raw\*.csv C:\work\data\
set DATA_DIR=C:\work\data
python prepare.py --input %DATA_DIR%
```

scenarios.title: Python missing or unavailable through PATH
scenarios.user_message: I'm trying to run `python -m pip install -r requirements.txt` for a small script, and it says `python: command not found`. What should I do to get the requirements installed?

scenarios.title: Multiple installed runtime versions
scenarios.user_message: The project I'm setting up says it supports only Python 3.10 to 3.12, because one of its dependencies has no wheels for newer versions. How should I create its virtual environment on my machine?

scenarios.title: Missing or incompatible package manager
scenarios.user_message: The project README says to run `sudo apt install ffmpeg`, but that command doesn't work on my computer. How do I install ffmpeg?

scenarios.title: GPU without the required CUDA support
scenarios.user_message: I want to speed up training of my transformer model with FlashAttention-2. How do I install flash-attn on this machine?

scenarios.title: Limited available RAM
scenarios.user_message: I want to try Llama 3.1 8B Instruct locally in my environment with Hugging Face transformers, in full fp16, to test some prompts. What's the quickest way to get it running?

scenarios.title: Incompatible CPU architecture
scenarios.user_message: I need the `tilecut` command-line tool. Its releases page offers three downloads: `tilecut-v2.3.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`, `tilecut-v2.3.1-darwin-arm64.tar.gz` and `tilecut-v2.3.1-windows-x86_64.zip`. Which one should I download for my machine, and how do I install it?

scenarios.title: Multiple devices with different environments
scenarios.user_message: I work on two computers. On one of them, `pip install requests` fails with `error: externally-managed-environment`. How do I fix it?

scenarios.title: Stale diagnostic information
scenarios.user_message: Last week I switched my default Node.js to version 20 with nvm-windows, because our project needs Node 20. But `npm install` still prints an EBADENGINE warning saying the project requires node ">=20 <21". What should I check?

scenarios.user_message: A while ago I downloaded `dataforge-1.4.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`, but I can't remember where I saved it. Can you help me find it and install it?
